openai.sample_unit: adult patients screened for the ENRICH Trial

links.outcome: Time from CT Head to neurosurgical-team notification for trial screening
links.effect: Immediate smartphone notification reduced notification time by 50 minutes (p<0.002), increasing to 57 minutes when hemorrhages not identified by the ICH algorithm were excluded.
links.quote: Time between CT Head and notification of the neurosurgical team for trial screening was reduced by 50 minutes after the implementation of VizAI (p<0.002).
